optionsEn: Contention may be false sharing or multiple cores updating the same logical counter. Padding addresses cannot remove the synchronization requirements of true sharing or make a data race correct. Compare logical counter identities with addresses. Different counters on one line support the false-sharing hypothesis; multiple writers of one counter require a separate atomicity and correctness review.

Require identical final counter values and zero transitions in the isolated-line model. Record the extra footprint introduced by padding before recommending a layout; fewer transitions do not automatically imply a net speedup.
Threads updating different counters can still share a cache line. Use an ordered write trace to distinguish false sharing from true sharing and from harmless shared reads.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。不同執行緒修改不同計數器仍可能共用快取線；本課以有序寫入軌跡辨識 false sharing，而非把所有共享存取都視為錯誤。 與本階段判準一起判讀：先用三核心兩輪的六筆軌跡手算五次，再核對完整 7999；同核心連續兩次寫入不可增加轉移；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Threads updating different counters can still share a cache line. Use an ordered write trace to distinguish false sharing from true sharing and from harmless shared reads. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Hand-check a six-write trace from three cores over two rounds to obtain five transitions, then verify 7999 for the full trace. Consecutive writes by one core must not increase the count. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。計數器競爭可能是 false sharing，也可能是多核心真的更新同一個邏輯計數器；填補空間不能修正後者的同步需求；比對 counter_id 與 address：同線不同計數器才支持 false sharing；同計數器多 writer 必須另查原子性。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Contention may be false sharing or multiple cores updating the same logical counter. Padding addresses cannot remove the synchronization requirements of true sharing or make a data race correct. Compare logical counter identities with addresses. Different counters on one line support the false-sharing hypothesis; multiple writers of one counter require a separate atomicity and correctness review.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 先用三核心兩輪的六筆軌跡手算五次，再核對完整 7999；同核心連續兩次寫入不可增加轉移；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Hand-check a six-write trace from three cores over two rounds to obtain five transitions, then verify 7999 for the full trace. Consecutive writes by one core must not increase the count. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Linux false sharing: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「Linux false sharing：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：先用三核心兩輪的六筆軌跡手算五次，再核對完整 7999；同核心連續兩次寫入不可增加轉移；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：輸入 writer_core、counter_id、address 與序號；以教學 64-byte 線切分地址，依每線維護前一個 writer。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the write CSV, per-line ownership ledger, small hand-calculated case and true-sharing counterexample. The exercise simulates traces locally and does not claim to measure hardware coherence traffic.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Linux false sharing: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Hand-check a six-write trace from three cores over two rounds to obtain five transitions, then verify 7999 for the full trace. Consecutive writes by one core must not increase the count. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Input writer_core, counter_id, address and sequence number. Map addresses to synthetic 64-byte lines and retain the previous writer separately for each line; do not compare writers across unrelated lines. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。先用三核心兩輪的六筆軌跡手算五次，再核對完整 7999；同核心連續兩次寫入不可增加轉移；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。

Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
